portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* Previously, it was not possible to set node attributes for Pacemaker Remote nodes with uppercase letters in their name. With this update, Pacemaker now correctly uses a case-insensitive search. As a result, attributes of Pacemaker Remote nodes with uppercase letters in their name work as expected. (BZ#1583747)

* Previously, Pacemaker unnecessarily recovered already recovered resources. This happened when a resource, including stonith devices and Pacemaker Remote connections, with the "requires" meta-attribute set to "quorum" or "nothing" was recovered on a new node before the old node was fenced. With this update, Pacemaker no longer counts instances of resources with "requires" set to "quorum" or "nothing" as being active on failed nodes awaiting fencing. As a result, nodes running a resource with "requires" set to "quorum" or "nothing" are recovered only once. (BZ#1585741)

Users of pacemaker are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
